title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率
authors: Ilhan Guner, Christian Siegel, Ilhan Guner; Christian Siegel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels -- firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营任务和管理任务中同时使用认知技能、人际交往技能和操作技能，不同行业的技能密集度存在差异，且由于企业特有的技术冲击，同一行业内企业规模呈现异质性。基于英国数据校准的模型表明，认知技能是制约生产率的关键因素。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。行业层面约一半的影响源于行业内分布的变化——大型企业相对规模扩大，但生产率反而下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性进一步放大了这些效应。

title: Agricultural commercialization and productivity: Evidence from land market participation in rural China
title_zh: 农业商业化与生产率：来自中国农村土地市场参与的实证证据
authors: Jian Zhang, Ashok K. Mishra, Maximilian Koppenberg, Linyi Zheng
abstract: Abstract This study utilizes nationally representative panel data on rural Chinese households to investigate the interrelationship between smallholders’ participation in land rental markets and their agricultural commercialization while also evaluating the interactive effects of these market‐oriented farming practices on agricultural land and labor productivity. We adopted a bivariate Tobit model, fixed effects models, and instrumental variable methods to address the endogeneity problems. Results reveal a mutually reinforcing relationship between farm households’ land rental area and commercialization decisions. Furthermore, renting farmland is associated with improved agricultural labor productivity and reduced land productivity. Agricultural commercialization shows a positive correlation with the productivity of both land and labor for farm households. Finally, commercialization could positively moderate the association between land renting and agricultural productivity. Policymakers should design policies and strategies to promote the development of the land rental market and the commercialization of farmers, which could improve labor and land productivity.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的中国农村家庭面板数据，探讨小农户参与土地租赁市场与其农业商业化之间的相互关系，同时评估这些市场化农业实践对农业土地和劳动生产率的交互效应。我们采用双变量Tobit模型、固定效应模型和工具变量方法来解决内生性问题。结果显示，农户土地租赁面积与商业化决策之间存在相互促进的关系。此外，租赁耕地与农业劳动生产率提高和土地生产率下降相关。农业商业化与农户土地和劳动生产率均呈正相关。最后，商业化能够正向调节土地租赁与农业生产率之间的关系。政策制定者应设计促进土地租赁市场发展和农民商业化的政策与策略，从而提升劳动和土地生产率。

title: Monopsony Makes Firms Not Only Small but Also Unproductive: Why East Germany has Not Converged
title_zh: 买方垄断不仅使企业规模变小，还导致其低效率：东德为何未能实现经济趋同
authors: Rüdiger Bachmann, Christian Bayer, Heiko Stüber, Felix Wellschmied
abstract: Abstract When employers face a trade-off between being large and paying low wages—and in this sense have monopsony power—some productive employers decide against building large business networks, forgo sales, and remain small. These decisions have adverse consequences for aggregate labour productivity. Using high-quality administrative data from Germany, we document that East German plants (compared to West German ones) face steeper size-wage curves, invest less in their business networks, remain smaller, and are less productive. A model with labour market monopsony, product market power, and business network investments matching these features of the data predicts a 10% lower aggregate labour productivity in East Germany.
